verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Tailscale CLI with a reference page at /docs/reference/tailscale-cli, and a community user reports hands-on use of the 'tailscale cert' subcommand. Docs also describe an official Aperture CLI for discovering, configuring and running coding agents, plus a Tailscale skill for coding agents, which supports the AI-native angle. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of the CLI's contents (command coverage, machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth for agents) and broader independent corroboration of CLI use in agent workflows.
